name: Character Origin Selection and Inheritance

upbringings.description: Select one effective Upbringing. A Species or Ancestry default is a suggestion, not an extra automatically granted Upbringing and not a Species restriction. An explicit Upbringing choice replaces the suggested default. The selected Upbringing inherits any Upbringing parent benefits once, without requiring a second selection. Only records with selectable: true can be chosen directly; an inheritance-only parent contributes benefits solely through a selected child.

parentSelectability.description: Any Upbringing referenced as another Upbringing's parent is nonselectable by default. It may be independently chosen only when it explicitly sets both selectable: true and allowParentSelection: true. Nonselectable parents grant benefits through one selected child, never as an additional selection.

reviewNotes: Mixed Ancestry is a separate design question and is not required for directly selected Species and Ancestry.
Character selection and grant authorization remain unimplemented; this JSON is authoritative content rather than an executable character builder.
General Elf and General Gnome are inheritance-only nonselectable parents. Their children retain inherited cultural benefits; Species defaults cannot point to these parents.
Upbringings serving as parents are inheritance-only by default; a separately selectable parent requires explicit allowParentSelection.

Duplicate Skill and specific-tool proficiencies follow same-kind replacement. Duplicate Competency proficiency follows the separate optional-resolution contract; duplicate languages and broad/narrow weapon overlap do not create automatic alternatives.

skillProficiency.description: If independent authorized sources grant the same Skill proficiency, choose a different Skill proficiency instead of losing the redundant grant. Do not add a rank.

toolProficiency.description: If independently earned binary proficiencies cover the same specific tool type, choose another eligible tool proficiency. Do not turn a tool qualification into a ranked Competency.

competencyProficiency.description: Competency duplication follows the separately configured policy: provisional same-Competency rank conversion or an authorized alternative Competency proficiency.

weaponAndOtherEquipment.description: Repeated or overlapping broad/narrow weapon and other non-tool equipment qualifications retain source provenance. They do not award another proficiency or mastery by implication.

language.description: Language duplication is not covered by the 5e Skill/tool duplicate rule; no new language grant has been approved by this pass.
